title: Handling of NAS COUNT and NAS sequence number

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter value used in NAS security procedures for replay protection and freshness.

entities.name: NAS sequence number
entities.description: Sequence number included in NAS messages for ordering and security purposes.

entities.name: Replay protection
entities.description: Security mechanism to prevent acceptance of replayed NAS messages.

relations.description: NAS COUNT enables replay protection by ensuring message freshness.
NAS sequence number is part of the NAS COUNT value.
